data.narrative:
True Anomaly, a Defense & Security frontier-tech company, recently completed a SPAC transaction at a $2.2B valuation after raising over $1B. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 16 same-sector peers at similar valuation tiers, spanning 2 public and 8 private companies. Lead private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, with public references from DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Peer-median analysis anchors the valuation framework. The 16-company cohort yields a median valuation of $2.3B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $9.2B. Within this set, Saronic ($9.2B, Series D), Quantum-Systems ($8.0B, Series C), and Flock Safety ($7.5B, Series G) represent the upper tier, while Chaos Industries ($4.5B, Series D) and Skydio ($4.4B, Series F) occupy the mid-range. This single-method triangulation is constrained by the availability of comparable transaction data in the sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $2.7B, centered on the peer median of $2.3B. True Anomaly's current $2.2B price sits at the lower end of this range, implying 5% upside to median. Key uncertainties include revenue multiples and growth trajectories within the Defense & Security peer set, and the limited applicability of public comps given stage and revenue profile differences. Revenue and margin data would strengthen conviction in this range.
